summary.text: EGERSUND GROUP AS is a private limited company registered in Egersund, founded 1998-03-16. Egersund Group AS is a holding company that invests in shares and securities, and its statutory purpose also covers investment activity and renting out real estate, including participation in other enterprises, including through board positions. It was previously named HÅDYR AS until 2009-08-04. Its main industry code is 13.940: manufacture of cordage, rope, twine and netting. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-01 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
